item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "5b180b224bf13e32996d504b990b2a7d2af1ca76e9caa2ea8db63bd5310266c7",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "For a field q(x,t) valued in real vectors indexed by a finite type, asserts the existence of vectors qt and qx that are respectively the derivatives of τ ↦ q(x,τ) at t and ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) at x, with qt + coefficient·qx = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Each traveling field has both partial derivatives at the specified point and satisfies the homogeneous matrix equation there. The derivative witnesses are existential inside each pointwise conclusion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "The vector field (x,t) ↦ profile(x − speed·t) times the specified vector.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines the two fields using speeds −c and c and vectors (−ρc,1) and (ρc,1), respectively.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "The vector indexed by Fin 2 with coordinates (−density·soundSpeed, 1), in index order 0,1.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specifies the claimed nonzero eigenvector for eigenvalue −c and the vector factor of its traveling field.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "The real matrix with rows (0, bulkModulus) and (density⁻¹, 0).",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the matrix in both eigenvector equations and both partial differential equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "The vector indexed by Fin 2 with coordinates (density·soundSpeed, 1), in index order 0,1.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specifies the claimed nonzero eigenvector for eigenvalue c and the vector factor of its traveling field.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "LocalDef006",
      "meaning": "Real scalar multiplication on the function space ι → Real is jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity of scalar multiplication for the vector-valued derivative predicate; it adds no hypothesis on the profile.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "LocalDef007",
      "meaning": "Evaluates an arbitrary E-valued profile at x − speed·t.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the phases x + ct and x − ct of the two real profiles.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "Algebra.id",
      "meaning": "A commutative semiring regarded as an algebra over itself, with identity algebra map and multiplication as scalar action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Real scalars act on real coordinates by ordinary multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "Algebra.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar multiplication operation from an algebra structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses the real self-algebra scalar action in the vector scalar products.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction.",
      "effect_on_target": "All seven main assertions hold together; within the PDE predicate both derivative assertions and the equation hold together.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "CommSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying semiring, retaining its operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real semiring structure required for scalar multiplication without changing arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "ContinuousMul.to_continuousSMul",
      "meaning": "Joint continuity of multiplication gives joint continuity of the multiplication scalar action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real-valued derivative predicate with the usual real scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "A densely normed field supplies a nontrivially normed field with the same underlying normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar field structure required for real differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "DivInvMonoid.toDiv",
      "meaning": "Extracts division from a division-and-inverse monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies division in bulkModulus/density.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two terms of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The matrix-vector equations and zero PDE residual are exact vector equalities, hence equalities at both coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Fin",
      "meaning": "Fin n is the type of natural-number indices strictly less than n.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fin 2 fixes exactly two coordinates, indexed 0 and 1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "Fin.fintype",
      "meaning": "Enumerates all indices in Fin n.",
      "effect_on_target": "Matrix-vector multiplication sums over both indices 0 and 1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "Function.hasSMul",
      "meaning": "Lifts scalar multiplication on a codomain to pointwise scalar multiplication on functions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Multiplication of a scalar and a two-component vector acts on each coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "HDiv.hDiv",
      "meaning": "Selects the division operation from the specified heterogeneous division instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Here computes the real quotient bulkModulus/density.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "HMul.hMul",
      "meaning": "Selects multiplication from the specified heterogeneous multiplication instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Here uses real multiplication in phases and vector coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
      "meaning": "Selects the scalar action from the specified heterogeneous scalar multiplication instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms scalar multiples of vectors in the eigenvector equations and traveling fields.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "HSub.hSub",
      "meaning": "Selects subtraction from the specified heterogeneous subtraction instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms the real phase x − speed·t.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "The function has the specified derivative at the specified point, using the neighborhood of that point and the fixed base point in the derivative filter.",
      "effect_on_target": "The profile assumptions are ordinary real derivatives at individual phase points; the PDE conclusions require derivatives of real-to-vector slices at individual points, without a restricted domain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "IsTopologicalRing.toIsTopologicalSemiring",
      "meaning": "A topological ring supplies the continuity properties of a topological semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports continuity of real multiplication used by the derivative structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "IsTopologicalSemiring.toContinuousMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts joint continuity of multiplication from a topological semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides continuous real scalar multiplication through multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "LT.lt",
      "meaning": "Selects a strict comparison relation from an ordered-type instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses strict positivity of both parameters and of c in the real order.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "Matrix.mulVec",
      "meaning": "The i-th coordinate of M·v is the finite dot product of row i of M with v, namely the sum of M(i,j)v(j) over j.",
      "effect_on_target": "For the specified matrix, A·(a,b) = (bulkModulus·b, density⁻¹·a).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "Nat",
      "meaning": "The natural numbers including zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the dimension 2 and finite coordinate indices, not an additional quantified parameter.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "Ne",
      "meaning": "Negation of equality.",
      "effect_on_target": "Each specified vector differs from the zero vector; this does not require every coordinate to be nonzero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "Neg.neg",
      "meaning": "Extracts the negation operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms the negative speed −c using real additive negation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the operations of a nonunital commutative ring while exposing a structure that does not require associativity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the instance path supplying real arithmetic for matrix-vector multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital, nonassociative ring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains ordinary real operations in the matrix arithmetic instance path.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, multiplication, zero, and distributivity while discarding the requirement of additive inverses.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies exactly the arithmetic structure required by Matrix.mulVec.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the algebraic nonunital commutative ring underlying a normed one.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real ring operations for matrix-vector multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital seminormed ring with unchanged operations and seminorm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real additive and norm structures used in differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive commutative group, and pseudometric of a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive norm structure for the real normed-space instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Keeps the same real field and norm along derivative-related instance paths.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, metric, and ring operations while omitting the multiplicative identity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies a weaker real structure for matrix arithmetic without changing its operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains a normed commutative ring's operations, norm, and underlying pseudometric as a seminormed structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the standard real topology and additive structures in the derivative predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed commutative ring underlying a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real arithmetic and metric in the differentiation infrastructure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A normed field is a normed vector space over itself, with multiplication as scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Real-valued profiles are differentiated as maps into the usual real vector space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module underlying a normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real module structure needed by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number numeral through the chosen numeral instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets real and vector zero and the natural-number dimension 2 in their respective types.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "Pi.instZero",
      "meaning": "The zero function has zero in every coordinate.",
      "effect_on_target": "The vector zero in nonvanishing assertions and the PDE is (0,0).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the real metric to the topology used for derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The real-number type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both parameters, c, coordinates, profile values, derivative values, x, and t are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The densely normed field structure on the reals, built from their normed field structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the nontrivial normed scalar field for differentiation without an additional assumption.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The additive commutative group structure on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real addition and additive inverses in real-valued calculus.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "Real.instCommSemiring",
      "meaning": "The commutative semiring structure on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the identity real algebra and its multiplication scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "Real.instDivInvMonoid",
      "meaning": "Real multiplication, inversion, and division, with division given by multiplication by the inverse.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets bulkModulus/density as bulkModulus·density⁻¹.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "Real.instLT",
      "meaning": "The strict order on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both parameter assumptions and the speed conclusion use ordinary strict positivity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "Real.instMul",
      "meaning": "Real multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Multiplies density by c and speed by t.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "Real.instNeg",
      "meaning": "Real additive negation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the negative speed and the first coordinate of the negative-speed vector.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "Real.instSub",
      "meaning": "Real subtraction, defined as addition of the additive inverse.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes x − (−c)t equal to x + ct and the other phase x − ct.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The real number zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the positivity threshold, matrix diagonal entries, and vector residual zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "The usual real commutative ring equipped with its norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies arithmetic for matrix-vector products and norm-related structures for derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The real field equipped with its norm and metric, with total inversion satisfying inverse of zero equals zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports real differentiation and scalar arithmetic; positive density excludes the zero-denominator case.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real metric given by distance |x − y|, together with its associated uniform structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "The derivative predicates use the usual real topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "Real.sqrt",
      "meaning": "The nonnegative square root after truncating the argument to the nonnegative reals; it is zero on negative arguments.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines c as the nonnegative square root of bulkModulus/density; the positive parameter assumptions make the argument and c strictly positive.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains operations, seminorm, and pseudometric while dropping the identity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies an intermediate real seminormed structure used for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real metric and operations in the topology instance path.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric structure of a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real pseudometric underlying derivative-related topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology associated with a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the usual real neighborhoods in HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets numeral 0 as the zero of the specified type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures that real zero and function-space zero use their respective zero structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "instHDiv",
      "meaning": "Uses homogeneous division as heterogeneous division with the same input and output type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The quotient defining c is ordinary real division.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "instHMul",
      "meaning": "Uses homogeneous multiplication as heterogeneous multiplication on the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Phase and vector-coordinate products are real products.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "instHSMul",
      "meaning": "Exposes a scalar action as heterogeneous scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "The selected pointwise real scalar action is used in vector multiples.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "instHSub",
      "meaning": "Uses homogeneous subtraction as heterogeneous subtraction on the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The phase subtraction is real subtraction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "instIsTopologicalRingReal",
      "meaning": "The reals form a topological ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides continuity of real arithmetic needed by the derivative structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "instOfNatNat",
      "meaning": "A natural-number numeral denotes that same natural number.",
      "effect_on_target": "The dimension literal 2 is exactly the natural number two.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "DFunLike.coe",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying function from a function-like object.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows structural maps to be applied as functions; it introduces no new mathematical transformation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring underlying a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains real addition and multiplication in the vector module infrastructure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "Equiv",
      "meaning": "An equivalence between types, consisting of mutually inverse functions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Packages the identity conversion between a two-index function and a matrix.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "Equiv.instEquivLike",
      "meaning": "Exposes an equivalence's forward function, inverse, and inverse laws.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows Matrix.of to be used via its forward function.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "EquivLike.toFunLike",
      "meaning": "Treats an equivalence-like object as a function-like object using the same forward map.",
      "effect_on_target": "Applying Matrix.of preserves the displayed row and column entries.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over a witness satisfying a predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Within each PDE conclusion there exist qt and then qx, both real two-component vectors, satisfying the derivative assertions and equation for that field and point.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Retains a field's semiring, division, inversion, and related laws while omitting additive inverse requirements.",
      "effect_on_target": "An instance conversion for real scalar structures; it does not restrict real values to nonnegative numbers.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "Fintype",
      "meaning": "A finite enumeration containing every element of a type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Permits finite matrix sums; the target supplies the enumeration of Fin 2.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "Selects addition from a heterogeneous addition instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms the vector sum qt + A·qx and real additions used in subtraction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "Inv.inv",
      "meaning": "Extracts the inverse operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets density⁻¹ in the matrix as the real reciprocal, since density is positive.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "Matrix",
      "meaning": "A matrix with row type m, column type n, and entries in α is a function m → n → α.",
      "effect_on_target": "The coefficient is a real 2-by-2 matrix with the first index selecting the row.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "Matrix.of",
      "meaning": "The identity equivalence from a two-index function to the corresponding matrix.",
      "effect_on_target": "Does not transpose or otherwise change the displayed coefficient array.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "Matrix.vecCons",
      "meaning": "Prepends a head entry at index 0 to a finite vector, shifting its previous entries to successor indices.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the coordinate order of both eigenvectors and the row and column order of the matrix.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "Matrix.vecEmpty",
      "meaning": "The unique vector indexed by the empty type Fin 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Terminates the displayed finite vectors; the constructed target vectors and matrix dimensions are two, not empty.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative monoid underlying a nonunital, nonassociative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides addition and zero for finite real sums and module structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts a weaker semiring structure with the same operations and no associativity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real arithmetic in the instance infrastructure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D087",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the algebraic field from a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary real field operations for scalar and vector structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D088",
      "name": "One.toOfNat1",
      "meaning": "Interprets numeral 1 as the multiplicative identity.",
      "effect_on_target": "The second coordinate of each specified vector is exactly real one.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D089",
      "name": "Pi.Function.module",
      "meaning": "A function space into a module is a module under pointwise operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "The derivative vectors and traveling fields take values in the usual real vector space Real².",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D090",
